user_problem: A draft silently assumes reader knowledge, access, motivation, or context that may not be supplied.
unique_output: An annotation list identifying exact passages, assumption type, consequence, and bounded clarification option.
required_input: Complete draft, declared audience profile, known prerequisites, available resources, and excluded assumptions.
critical_rule: Do not stereotype the audience; flag only assumptions evidenced by the text and profile mismatch.
nearest_existing_and_difference: Nearest is tutorial-prerequisite-mapper; this annotates assumptions throughout prose rather than mapping prerequisites to procedural steps.
acceptance_scenario: Input audience is first-time staff with browser access only; draft says 'open the admin console as usual.' Output flags prior familiarity and unavailable admin access, then requests an access prerequisite or alternate path.
